# Mamber Hub Website — Real Assets

Replace these placeholders with the real Mamber Hub assets:

- `mamber-hub-logo.svg` — current temporary brand mark
- `app-login.png` — real app login screenshot
- `app-dashboard.png` — real member dashboard screenshot
- `app-videos.png` — real video gallery screenshot
- `app-payments.png` — real payment history screenshot

Recommended screenshot size: 1080×1920 PNG or JPG.

Also update in `src/main.jsx`:
- WhatsApp number/link
- Play Store/APK link
- Final membership price
- Social media links

Do not upload Firebase credentials or `google-services.json` to this website's public assets.
